[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Torrie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the callsign "Starfall leader," Captain Torrie led [[Task Force on Alliance Security|Task Force]] [[Task Force Starfall|Starfall]] in the [[Attack on the Subjugator|attack]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']] at [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. After a group of Alliance agents aided in the escape of [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] from the ''Subjugator'', Captain Torrie picked up their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and congratulated them on their efforts.

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Torrie was created for the [[West End Games]] RPG adventure module ''Starfall'' as the commander of the task force of the same name. His species was not established until the release of ''Classic Adventure: Volume Five'', which included ''Starfall'' with additional pictures, including one of Torrie.
